description: Manages external links associated with various entities within the system.

endpoints.name: GetLinks
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of links associated with a specific entity (e.g., Project, Partner) and its unique identifier. Results can be ordered and paginated.

entity.description: The type of entity the links are associated with (e.g., 'Project', 'Partner').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity.

orderBy.description: Field to sort the results by.

ascending.description: Sort order: true for ascending, false for descending.

direction.description: Sort direction: true for ascending, false for descending (alternative to ascending).

pageIndex.description: The 0-based index of the page to retrieve.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

example_uses: Get all links for Project with ID 123.
List links for Partner 456, sorted by name in ascending order, on the second page with 10 items per page.
Find all external resources related to Contact 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch all external links related to a particular business entity, such as a project, partner, or contact, with options for pagination and sorting.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new external link and associates it with a specified entity and its ID. Both the entity type and entity ID are required.

entity.description: The type of entity the link will be associated with (e.g., 'Project', 'Partner').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity to associate the link with.

url.description: The URL of the external link.

name.description: A descriptive name for the link.

example_uses: Create a new link 'Project Documentation' with URL 'http://docs.example.com' for Project 123.
Add a link to the 'Partner Agreement' for Partner 456.
Register a new external resource for Contact 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to add a new external link (e.g., a document, website, or resource) and connect it to an existing entity in the system.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing external link identified by its unique ID. The entity type and entity ID must also be provided to ensure the link's context is maintained.

id.description: The unique identifier of the link to update.

entity.description: The type of entity the link is associated with (e.g., 'Project', 'Partner').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity the link is associated with.

url.description: The updated URL of the external link.

name.description: The updated descriptive name for the link.

example_uses: Update the URL of link 5 to 'http://newdocs.example.com' for Project 123.
Change the name of link 10 to 'Revised Agreement' for Partner 456.
Modify the details of an existing external resource for Contact 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify the details (URL or name) of an already existing external link.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Deletes an external link from the system using its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the link to delete.

example_uses: Remove the external resource identified by ID 15.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove an external link from the system.
